outcome: intent to prevent obstetric fistula recurrence
cohort: 478 women with obstetric fistulas in five fistula treatment centers in Addis Ababa and Oromia regions, Ethiopia.
finding: Living in a rural setting, being married, having one previous repair, high self-esteem, psychological health, living with fistula >=5 years, high knowledge of risk factors, and a positive attitude were significant predictors of intent to prevent obstetric fistula recurrence.
